text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The showdown with Mr. C.B. ends in... 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their battle, however, was only just 
beginning. The two immediately began 
discussing the future, wondering who would 
claim the next victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky watched over 
the two as they enjoyed the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And they hold high hopes... that Sakura 
Chiyono O's legs will leave everyone in 
absolute awe.
